title: Resolve the next maintainer-approved GitHub issue of 0x0pointer/skills with a reviewed spec, code...

goal.value: Resolve the next maintainer-approved GitHub issue of 0x0pointer/skills with a reviewed spec, code, and passing tests

inputs.repo_rules: Skills are changed here, in this repository. agent-smith and Construct include it as a git submodule and pick changes up through their own update pull requests, so there is nothing to change in those repositories.
inputs.test_notes: This repository has no unit tests. The check that runs here is python3 validate_skills.py, which validates the frontmatter of every SKILL.md. CI also runs a SkillSpector scan of the changed skills, which cannot run in this sandbox.
inputs.repo_description: a library of agent skills: one directory per skill holding a SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter plus instructions) and its reference files, with a few small maintenance scripts. Skills are instructions that security-testing agents follow, so a change of wording is a change of behaviour

script.String: cat /tmp/fabro/review-brief.md; wc -l /tmp/fabro/change.diff; echo '{"verdict": "pass", "needs_security_review": true, "summary": "ok but touches auth", "findings": []}' > /tmp/fabro/review.json
mkdir -p /tmp/fabro; echo test issue > /tmp/fabro/issue.md; echo 1 > /tmp/fabro/issue_number; pwd; git log -1 --oneline; git branch -a | head -5; ls .fabro/skills 2>&1

label.String: Approve the spec? To have it revised, type what should change.

script.String: printf 'Risk level: low\nTests required: no\n' > /tmp/fabro/spec.md; cat /tmp/fabro/spec.md
ls /tmp/fabro; test -f /tmp/fabro/review-notes.md && ! test -f /tmp/fabro/todo.md && echo WOULD-LABEL-BUILT || echo WOULD-LABEL-FAILED

label.String: Automatic fixing did not converge. Stop, or allow one more attempt?

script.String: n=$(cat /tmp/fabro/impl.n 2>/dev/null || echo 0); n=$((n+1)); echo $n > /tmp/fabro/impl.n; echo implement visit $n; if [ $n -ge 2 ]; then echo change-$n >> zz_routing_test.txt; fi; ls /tmp/fabro

n=$(cat /tmp/fabro/sec.n 2>/dev/null || echo 0); n=$((n+1)); echo $n > /tmp/fabro/sec.n; echo security_review visit $n; ls /tmp/fabro; if [ $n -eq 1 ]; then echo '{"verdict": "fail", "summary": "one", "findings": [{"severity": "blocking", "category": "injection", "file": "zz", "line": 1, "problem": "p", "fix": "f"}]}' > /tmp/fabro/review.json; else echo '{"verdict": "pass", "summary": "fixed", "findings": []}' > /tmp/fabro/review.json; fi
